stories.summary: Sixteen finalists gathered near Paris to compete for the title of world egg mayonnaise champion, held in Saint-Ouen, just outside Paris, on Monday 23 November 2026. The competition celebrates a deceptively simple French bistro classic that demands considerable culinary skill.

stories.title: Colombia: At least 25 injured in bombing as armed violence resurges

stories.title: Ukraine confirms it used naval drones to strike two Russian ships off Libya
stories.summary: Ukraine’s security service says seven drones were launched from mothership in operation that sank Merkury warship Ukraine has confirmed it deployed naval drones in strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya on Sunday, including one that sank the corvette Merkury, one of Russia’s newest vessels. Ukraine’s security service, the SBU, said seven domestically made naval drones were launched from a mothership in the operation, which Volodymyr Zelenskyy described as “exemplary”. stories.title: Twenty Gaza students due to leave for Ireland after winning visa battle

The group is due to leave the territory on Monday under strict Israeli controls and travel via Jordan to Dublin to take up places at Irish universities. Another group is expected to follow next month.

stories.title: South Korea tells island residents to take shelter after Russian military aircraft approach

The defence ministry said it would summon the Russian defence attaché on Tuesday afternoon to lodge a strong protest. Continue reading..
